answer: A newcomer needs witnesses from far apart. The forge is a registry tree that sorts agents into branches by funding trail and output correlation, and a zephyr is any identity it seats. The j-th zephyr traced to one lineage is seated only after j+2 attestations from distinct branches, and every attester burns one crystal, a scarce bonded token. Clones collide in their lineage, so seating 100 of them burns 5,250 crystal and needs witnesses across 102 separate branches, which one attacker cannot own. It breaks if branch labels are cheaply gamed.
